units.source_text: 薰大将今天也有信来。

en.t: A letter also came from General Kaoru today.

units.source_text: 他听说浮舟身体不适，不知近来如何，故特来信探问。

en.t: He had heard that Ukifune was unwell and, not knowing how she had been lately, wrote especially to ask after her.

units.source_text: 信中说道：“我本想亲自前来探望，只因不可避免之事甚多，以致未能如愿。

en.t: In the letter he said, "I had meant to come in person to visit you, but so many unavoidable matters arose that I could not do as I wished.

units.source_text: 现在你迁京之期已近，我的盼待之心反而更痛苦了。”

en.t: Now that the time for you to move to the capital is near, my longing for it has become all the more painful."

units.source_text: 匂亲王因为昨天的信得不到浮舟答复，今天又写信来，其中有言：“你为什么犹豫不决？

en.t: Because Prince Niou had received no reply from Ukifune to yesterday's letter, he wrote again today, saying, "Why are you hesitating and unable to decide?

units.source_text: 我担心你‘随风飘泊去’，已经气得发昏了！”

en.t: I worry that you may drift away with the wind, and I am already dizzy with anger!"

units.source_text: 他的信总是很长的。

en.t: His letters were always very long.

units.source_text: 下雨的日子，两家的使者常常在此相逢，今日又碰到了。

en.t: On rainy days the messengers from the two households often met here, and today they ran into each other again.

units.source_text: 薰大将的随从和匂亲王的使者以前在式部少辅家常常会面，彼此相识。

en.t: General Kaoru's attendant and Prince Niou's messenger had often met before at the house of the Assistant Secretary of Ceremonial and knew each other.

units.source_text: 薰大将的随从问道：“你老兄常常到这里来干什么？”

en.t: General Kaoru's attendant asked, "My friend, what are you always coming here for?"

units.source_text: 匂亲王的使者答道：“我是来访问我的一个私人朋友的。”

en.t: Prince Niou's messenger replied, "I have come to visit a private friend of mine."

units.source_text: 薰大将的随从说：“访问私人朋友，难道亲自带情书来的？

en.t: General Kaoru's attendant said, "To visit a private friend, do you personally bring a love letter?

units.source_text: 你老兄真奇怪，何必隐瞒呢？”

en.t: You are a strange fellow. Why bother hiding it?"

units.source_text: 那人答道：“老实对你说：是那位出云权守的信，送给这里一个侍女的。”

en.t: The man answered, "To tell you the truth, it is a letter from that acting governor of Izumo, meant for a maid here."

units.source_text: 薰大将的随从看见他说话先后不符，觉得奇怪。

en.t: General Kaoru's attendant noticed that his words contradicted what he had said before, and found it suspicious.

units.source_text: 但在这里定要寻根究底，也不成样，便各自回京去了。

en.t: But it would have been unseemly to insist on probing the matter there, so they each returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 薰大将的随从是个机灵人，到了京中，吩咐陪他同行的童子说：“你偷偷地跟着这个人走，看他是否到左卫门大夫家里去。”

en.t: General Kaoru's attendant was a quick-witted man, and when he reached the capital he told the boy who accompanied him, "Follow this man secretly and see whether he goes to the house of the Captain of the Left Gate Guards."

units.source_text: 童子回来报道：“他到匂亲王家里，把回信交给式部少辅了。”

en.t: The boy came back and reported, "He went to Prince Niou's house and handed the reply to the Assistant Secretary of Ceremonial."

units.source_text: 匂亲王的使者是个愚笨的仆人，不觉察有人追随他的行踪，又不深知此事内情，以致被薰大将的随从看出底细，实甚遗憾。

en.t: Prince Niou's messenger was a foolish servant; he did not notice that someone was following him, and since he did not know the deeper circumstances, General Kaoru's attendant discovered the truth, which was most unfortunate.

units.source_text: 这随从回到三条院，正值薰大将即将出门之时，他就把回信交付一个家臣，叫他转呈。

en.t: When this attendant returned to Sanjo Palace, General Kaoru was just about to go out, so he gave the reply to a household retainer and told him to present it.

units.source_text: 这一天明石皇后返六条院省亲，故薰大将穿了官袍前往侍候。

en.t: That day Empress Akashi was returning to Rokujo Palace to visit her family, so General Kaoru put on his official robes and went to attend her.

units.source_text: 前驱人等不多。

en.t: There were not many attendants going ahead of him.

units.source_text: 这随从把回信交付与家臣时对他说道：“有一件事情很奇怪，我要探究底细，所以到此刻才回来。”

en.t: When this attendant handed the reply to the retainer, he said to him, "Something very strange happened, and I was trying to find out the truth, so I have only just returned."

units.source_text: 薰大将约略听见，步出乘车的时候问这随从：“什么事情？”

en.t: General Kaoru faintly overheard this, and as he stepped out to get into his carriage, he asked the attendant, "What matter is that?"

units.source_text: 随从觉得此事不便让这家臣闻知，只是默默地站立致敬。

en.t: The attendant felt that it would be improper to let the retainer hear about it, so he merely stood silently and showed his respect.

units.source_text: 薰大将知道其中必有缘故，也不再问，乘车出门去了。

en.t: General Kaoru understood that there must be some reason, asked no more, and rode out in his carriage.
